title: Ground-truth failure table document
description: The file packages/ground-truth/data/metropt3-failures.json (docs/dataset.md#the-failure-table): the corrected MetroPT-3 failure windows and everything the evaluation excludes from scoring. Forwarded verbatim inside gt-catalog. Timestamps are the data clock, read as UTC.

source.description: Where the table comes from and which file it was resolved against.

clock.description: The recorded timestamps carry no zone; the project reads them as UTC and says so here.

failures.description: The scored failures, in chronological order.

unlabelled_episodes.description: Episodes that look like a labelled failure but carry no label; excluded from precision and reported separately.

excluded_windows.description: Every window that is neither a positive nor a negative for scoring.

frozen_blocks.description: Stretches in which the logger repeated one row; the simulator marks them and the evaluation excludes them.

gaps_over_1h.description: Recording gaps longer than an hour, so the evaluation can plan scenarios without reading the source file.

failure_id.title: Failure id
failure_id.description: Identifier of a row of this table: F1 to F4, plus the addendum F4b.

nullable_ts.title: Optional instant
nullable_ts.description: An instant of the data clock, or null when the source records none.

failure.title: Failure
failure.description: One failure of the corrected table, with the published values kept beside the corrected ones.

uci_nr.description: The number the published table gives this row, or null for a row the published table does not carry.

start.description: Start of the scoring window, inclusive.

end.description: End of the scoring window, exclusive.

data_onset.description: First sample that shows the failure signature.

data_recovery.description: First sample after the failure signature ends.

onset_known.description: False when the logger was frozen across the true onset, so lead time is a lower bound.

precursor_from.description: First instant at which the signature is measurable ahead of the window, or null.

report_local.description: The operator report as the thesis records it, on the local clock, or null.

maintenance_verified.description: True when the data shows the intervention at the recorded hour.

accepted_fault_ids.description: Every cause the evaluation accepts as correct for this failure, the primary one first.

signature.description: Which of the two data-derived leak signatures this failure shows.

native_alarm_first.description: First activation of the low-pressure switch inside the window, or null when the controller never signalled.

in_headline.description: False for a row that is reported separately rather than counted in the headline metrics.

unlabelled_episode.title: Unlabelled episode
unlabelled_episode.description: A continuous-load episode with raised purge pressure that carries no label.

excluded_window.title: Excluded window
excluded_window.description: A window that counts neither as a positive nor as a negative; from is inclusive and to is exclusive.

frozen_block.title: Frozen block
frozen_block.description: A stretch of repeated rows written by a frozen logger.

gap.title: Recording gap
gap.description: A stretch with no rows at all, longer than an hour.
